text: A group of strangers wake in [a labyrinth of identical cube-shaped rooms|threat|evil places], where hatches lead only to more rooms and some hold [traps set off by motion, pressure and sound|rules|how it hunts]. Leaven searches the numbers etched on each hatch for a pattern, while Worth admits he designed the outer shell for [a bureaucracy that has forgotten why it was built|origin|a cruel society]. As theories fail and the rooms shift around them, [Quentin's anger turns on the others|threat|people in your own life].
